summary: Takes two float pointers a1/a2 interpreted as 2D vectors (x stored at a1[0]/+0x0, z stored at a1[2]/+0x8). Computes the projection of a2 onto a1: dot(a1,a2) / dot(a1,a1); returns 0.0 when the a1 length-squared is zero. Structural twin of ZeroVectorCheck (00404030) per the DERIVED cluster prelabel.

operations.description: v2 = a1[0]*a1[0] + a1[2]*a1[2]; squared length of a1 computed from fields +0x0 and +0x8.
If v2 == 0.0, return 0.0 (degenerate/zero-length a1 yields a zero projection).
Else compute (a2[2]*a1[2] + a1[0]*a2[0]) / v2, i.e. the scalar projection of a2 onto a1.
Return the computed projection, or 0.0 when a1 is the zero vector.
